description.value: Flavour Balance Espresso Bar is a neighbourhood café on Belmont Street in North Vancouver offering espresso drinks and vegetarian-friendly food, with both indoor and outdoor seating. The no-smoking policy and patio make it a potentially pleasant rest stop for cyclists passing through the area.
